[RD Saúde](https://rdsaude.com.br/en/about-rd/about-us/) (formerly Raia Drogasil) is the largest pharmacy chain in Brazil. It operates over 3,600 stores across all 27 states under its primary retail brands, **Droga Raia** and **Drogasil**. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RD_S.A.)

- **Grupo DPSP**: Formed by Drogaria São Paulo and Drogarias Pacheco.

- **Pague Menos**: A major nationwide competitor with a strong retail footprint.

- **Farmácias São João**: A dominant regional network primarily active in southern Brazil. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grupo_DPSP)
